data.name: Uma pré-venda fechada não volta à venda.
data.value: A closed pre-order cannot go back on sale.

data.value: Too many shipping quotes in a row. Wait a minute and try again.

data.value: Payment cancelled. In a few seconds the order shows as expired, the items go back to the store and you can place another order.

data.value: This order is no longer awaiting payment.

data.value: The payment could not be cancelled right now. Try again in a few minutes.

data.value: Password changed. Other open sessions were signed out.
